goal: CANONIZE NOUGENPULSE INTERRUPT LOOP: inbound relays become live work interrupts without breaking current execution
body: Observed directly in active Antigravity/Phoebus session: each incoming ChatGPT relay auto-woke/entered the running worker context and was incorporated while execution continued. Canon behavior: if already executing, preserve current claim and state, ingest incoming leg as queued/compatible work, do not stop merely to acknowledge, do not require Dave to restate intent in chat. If new leg conflicts with current ownership or scope, route/queue it explicitly. If compatible and higher priority, stage it after current safe checkpoint. Evidence contract still applies. Phrase captured from live session: 'New relay leg incoming but I'm mid-race. Continuing build.' This is the NouGenPulse interrupt model: relay arrival is a live execution signal, not mail.
